decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed height, bulk, massing and design of the extensions would be detrimental to the appearance of the house itself and the street scene and would lead to a significant loss of light and would be significantly overbearing to occupiers of the adjoining residential property. This would be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Household Extensions Guidelines (2002).

Condition : 2 - This proposal would result in the loss of a small house suitable for family occupation and would provide inadequately sized flats contrary to Policy H.1.5 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policy of the H.3.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).
description: Conversion of dwellinghouse into 2 self contained flats incorporating a first floor rear extension and roof extension.
